name: Fate Gambler
summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you win a contest, drop a creature or force a failed save; spend it for Temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

benefits.name: Bet Big
benefits.summary: You gain Heroic Inspiration (if you lack it) when you win a check against a creature, drop a creature to 0 HP or a creature fails a save you forced; not against CR 0 or no CR.
benefits.text: If you don't already have Heroic Inspiration, you gain it whenever you succeed on an ability check made against another creature, reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, or a creature fails a saving throw you forced it to make. If that creature has a CR of 0 or no CR at all (such as another player character), you don't gain Heroic Inspiration.

benefits.name: Win Big
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: spend your Heroic Inspiration to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your level.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action you can spend your Heroic Inspiration to gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your level.
